modules.rationale: Makes the completed research corpus usable without changing its evidence.

modules.month_1_scope: Canonical portfolio, account, holding, cash, transaction, attribution, and risk-state model.
modules.rationale: Provides the shared state foundation for Trade, Invest, and portfolio intelligence.

modules.month_1_scope: End-to-end lineage stages, identifiers, hashes, quality state, and upstream provenance contract.
modules.rationale: Auditability and causal integrity are prerequisites for every product domain.

modules.month_1_scope: Lifecycle and evidence schemas that preserve A-G identifiers and current states.
modules.rationale: Prevents ambiguous promotion and creates a common research/governance vocabulary.

modules.month_1_scope: Metric definitions and data contracts for portfolio performance and risk.
modules.rationale: High product value, sequenced after portfolio and lineage foundations.

modules.month_1_scope: Research-only observation governance for future unseen data; no activation.
modules.rationale: Preserves future evidence collection while keeping deployment semantics separate.

modules.month_1_scope: Broker-neutral capability and adapter contracts only.
modules.rationale: Portability matters, but no validated strategy or order path justifies earlier work.

modules.month_1_scope: Freshness, quality, coverage, licensing, run, and failure-state specifications.
modules.rationale: Operational confidence in data is needed before downstream analytics.

modules.month_1_scope: Information architecture for statuses, hashes, authorization, evidence, and audit events.
modules.rationale: Makes governance visible and reviewable across all modules.

modules.month_1_scope: Alert taxonomy, severity, ownership, acknowledgement, and escalation design.
modules.rationale: Depends on the data, risk, governance, and broker boundaries being stable.
